taskDescription: Drag the words into the correct boxes
resetDropDescription: Are you sure you want to reset this drop zone?
a11yCheck: Check the answers. The responses will be marked as correct, incorrect, or unanswered.
a11yShowSolution: Show the solution. The task will be marked with its correct solution.
a11yRetry: Retry the task. Reset all responses and start the task over again.
textField:
In Scratch, *Events* are like starting pistols that tell your code to go!

Use the *show* block to make a hidden character pop back onto the screen.

When you use an AND rule, *both* of your clues have to be right to win the game.

If you get a prize for wearing a red shirt or blue shoes, the word *OR* means you only need one of those things to be true!

To pick a number that is bigger than 2 and smaller than 10, we use the word *AND* to make sure it follows both rules.
